# Clip

> Compress MP4 and MOV in the browser. The file never leaves this device. Not a YouTube downloader.

The public origin is https://clip-local.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

## Tools

* [Compress video](https://clip-local.vercel.app) — Mediabunny + FFmpeg in this tab.

## Guides

* [How to compress](https://clip-local.vercel.app/how-to) — Drop, preset, download.
* [WhatsApp](https://clip-local.vercel.app/whatsapp) — Video-send vs document.
* [Email](https://clip-local.vercel.app/email) — Gmail 25 MB is the letter.
* [iPhone](https://clip-local.vercel.app/iphone) — Files vs Photos.
* [Limits](https://clip-local.vercel.app/limits) — Memory, not a daily cap.
* [FAQ](https://clip-local.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy.

## Not on this origin

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API and no `/blogs/` cluster.
